issues.explanation: The unique-violation mapping helper is copy-pasted in both queue actions instead of being shared.

conventions.evidence: Domain writes via app/Actions/* authorizing inside via Gate (CreateQueue.php:57, UpdateQueue.php:195, SetQueueAccess.php:126); policy in app/Policies/QueuePolicy.php:409-481; reversible migration with down() in 2026_10_29_000001_create_queue_access_table.php:66-68; #[Fillable] matching Ticket model; audit via Log::channel('audit') matching docs/ops pattern; docs/business-rules.md, docs/database-schema.md and CHANGELOG.md Added section updated in same diff

readability.evidence: app/Actions/CreateQueue.php:55, app/Actions/UpdateQueue.php:193, app/Actions/SetQueueAccess.php:124, app/Policies/QueuePolicy.php:441: small focused methods, clear names, updated Ticket::call PHPDoc; consistent with siblings, no dead code or debug output

requirements.evidence: CreateQueue.php:55-81 trims name, Str::slug default/explicit, per-entity unique pre-check plus QueryException->ValidationException race mapping, is_active=true; UpdateQueue.php:193-245 nullable name/slug/isActive with whereKeyNot own-slug allowance plus race mapping; no delete action; migration queue_access with cascades + unique(entity_membership_id,queue_id); QueuePermission Call='call'; SetQueueAccess.php:126-171 entity-mismatch/unknown-entry ValidationException, upsert on non-empty, delete + conditional audit granted/revoked with actor_id/queue_id/entity_membership_id; QueuePolicy create/update/manageAccess/call with corrupted non-array deny; CallNextTicket.php:30 authorize after active check; Ticket.php:367-386 lock, InactiveQueueException, authorize, then LogicException; docs and CHANGELOG updated

scope.evidence: All hunks serve task.md: 3 actions, enum, model, factory, migration, policy, 2 call-path enforcements, docs/business-rules.md, docs/database-schema.md, CHANGELOG.md, QueueManagementTest plus required CallNextTicketTest owner-membership fixes; no delete action added, no unrelated refactors

security.evidence: Gate::forUser authorize in every write/call path (CreateQueue create, UpdateQueue update, SetQueueAccess manageAccess, CallNextTicket call, Ticket::call call); input validated to ValidationException (name/slug length, permissions allow-list, cross-entity); mass-assignment limited via #[Fillable]; no Blade output or secrets; no client-trusted IDs

simplicity.evidence: Lean reuse of Str::slug, Gate, updateOrCreate, ValidationException; only duplication is identical private isUniqueViolation in app/Actions/CreateQueue.php:91 and app/Actions/UpdateQueue.php:248

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/QueueManagementTest.php:820-1060 covers create/slugify, per-entity uniqueness, unauthorized create/update, update combos, deactivation preserving tickets, policy matrix, corrupted permissions deny, grant/revoke audit plus no-log no-op, invalid/cross-entity/self-grant, every CallMode unauthorized with no ticket change, grant-then-call, auth-before-waiting, factory same-entity, enum count; tests/Feature/CallNextTicketTest.php adds owner membership instead of weakening assertions

review.summary: Implements the full queue lifecycle, queue_access grants with audit trail, QueuePolicy single source of truth, and both call-path enforcements with docs and thorough Pest tests. Only nit is the duplicated unique-violation helper, so approve with nits.
